title: Move Git remote and Pages rows from gh/mod.rs to gh/remote.rs, pages.rs
summary: Structure-pass job G3: move the Remote trait, GitRemote and its helpers (about lines 283-360) into gh/remote.rs, and the Pages items (PAGES_WORKFLOW, PagesRun, PagesHost and its GhClient impl, PagesReport, wait constants, wait_pages_run, watch_pages) into gh/pages.rs. This is a pure move of the same text, with `pub use` re-exports so `gh::` paths stay unchanged. Add a CHANGELOG entry. The audience is the structure-pass verifier, who checks the section 5 proof.

defaults_applied.how: test run and an unchanged test list prove no behavior change
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: G1 (gh/mod.rs) and G2 (gh/transport.rs) have landed; the repository shows both files.
The exact set of items in each row is taken from section 4 of structure-pass.md. Remote helpers such as parse_remote and https_github_repository move only if no other code in mod.rs uses them.
Items stay private or become pub(super) only as far as the split requires.
docs/design/structure-pass.md and the stale gh.rs path mentions in other docs are not edited; section 5 rule 7 bars that.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-core/src/gh/remote.rs holds the Git remote row (trait Remote, GitRemote and its impl, plus any helper used only by them), and gh/pages.rs holds the Pages row (PAGES_WORKFLOW, PagesRun, PagesHost, the GhClient impl of PagesHost, PagesReport, the PAGES_* constants, wait_pages_run, watch_pages). The moved text is identical to the old text, apart from visibility changes needed for the module split and import lines.

gh/mod.rs declares `mod remote; mod pages;` and re-exports every previously public name with `pub use`, so `gh::Remote`, `gh::GitRemote`, `gh::PagesHost`, `gh::PagesReport`, `gh::watch_pages` and the other public paths are unchanged.
The existing tests, including after_a_merge_the_branch_is_resynced_then_pages_watched_then_code_health_checked, are not edited beyond import lines, and no test is added or removed.
The job report lists the caller check for each moved name: a Grep of `gh::(Pages|watch_pages|Remote|GitRemote)` showing the same hits before and after, and the Grep for `gh\.rs` mentions.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the G3 move, stating that behavior is unchanged.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. All three pass, and the `cargo test -- --list` output matches the pre-change list.

out_of_scope: Moving Transport, Records, Host API, Early or Landing rows
Changing introspect.rs paths or the external_calls_guard constant
